## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
ROTATION, Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive — risk signals are mixed with cycle support. Confirmations: HYG/LQD showing CREDIT STRESS ↓ (HYG/LQD ratio falling → risk negative) and Consumer Cycle + Semis leadership rising (Consumer Cycle ↑; SOXX/XBI strength) provide the cycle/risk split consistent with ROTATION.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear easing short-term: VXX (1W: -11.95% | 1M: +10.62%) ↓ falling, status CORRECTION. Credit tension still present: HYG (1W: +1.30% | 1M: -0.56%) RECOVERY vs LQD (1W: +1.57% | 1M: -1.26%) RECOVERY yields HYG/LQD ↓ → credit stress rising; Stocks vs Bonds (SPY/TLT) (1W: +1.65% | 1M: -1.65%) ↑ rising, status RECOVERY.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-tightening: UUP (Dollar) (1W: +0.07% | 1M: +1.38%) → flat / ABOVE TREND while TLT (1W: +1.19% | 1M: -2.26%) RECOVERY — yield curve (↑ rising) shows slight steepening.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Growth/momentum tilt: XLK (1W: +2.63% | 1M: -2.63%) RECOVERY and XLF (1W: +1.65% | 1M: -2.61%) RECOVERY are outperforming; XLY (1W: -1.47% | 1M: -6.93%) BELOW TREND shows discretionary weakness. Style: Growth/momentum leading, confirmed by broad sector breadth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US on short-term bounce: SPY (1W: +1.66% | 1M: -4.02%) RECOVERY; Europe showing relative strength: VGK (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +2.09%) ABOVE TREND; China FXI (1W: +1.80% | 1M: -1.80%) RECOVERY but still lagging vs longer term.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Mixed: IWM (1W: +1.56% | 1M: -3.83%) RECOVERY and ARKK (1W: +1.74% | 1M: -8.50%) RECOVERY show some risk-seeking, while IBIT (1W: -2.19% | 1M: -8.37%) BELOW TREND signals crypto-related pressure — speculative flows uneven.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Precious metals bounce: GLD (1W: +7.18% | 1M: -8.98%) RECOVERY and SLV (1W: +8.26% | 1M: -12.68%) RECOVERY; industrial inputs mixed as CPER (1W: +3.12% | 1M: -4.45%) RECOVERY.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Mixed/rotational: USO (1W: +17.62% | 1M: +50.63%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +7.06% | 1M: +39.13%) ABOVE TREND, while XLE (1W: -3.69% | 1M: +6.13%) is in CORRECTION — watch sector vs commodity disconnect; UNG (1W: -4.14% | 1M: -3.65%) BELOW TREND for gas.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: XBI (1W: +4.08% | 1M: +2.01%) ABOVE TREND shows clean sector follow-through. Divergence: MAJOR divergence present — multiple core ETFs (SPY, XLK, XLF, TLT) show 1W ↑ vs 1M ↓ → transitional bias that tempers strong regime conviction.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposures showing multi-week pick-up (XBI, XLK, XLF); reduce exposure to single-asset speculative crypto exposure (IBIT) and XLE until sector confirms (XLE CORRECTION). Monitor HYG/LQD ratio and VXX for credit/fear regime shifts.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Materials/XLB (if XLB keeps 1W strength) — watch CPER and XLB flows. BEARISH: Energy/XLE (if XLE fails to follow USO/BNO) — watch sector vs commodity divergence.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Oil/USO & BNO (momentum and supply headlines). BEARISH: Natural gas/UNG if heating-demand softness continues.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~34.7 (current fear pocket; watch break higher for renewed risk-off), HYG/LQD ratio ~0.73 (credit stress signal), XLK/XLF ratio ~2.75 (growth vs financials pivot), SPY/TLT (Stocks vs Bonds) (1W: +1.65% | 1M: -1.65%) — watch if Stocks/TLT re-accelerates.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION, Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive; risk signals are mixed with cycle support (HYG/LQD ↓ and Consumer Cycle ↑). XBI and XLK/XLF showing relative strength while XLE and IBIT show weakness. Key risk: MAJOR 1W vs 1M divergences across core ETFs and rising credit-stress signal (HYG/LQD) to monitor.
